facts.fact: According to Gartner, a typical B2B buying group involves six to ten decision makers.
facts.quote: a typical B2B buying group involves six to ten decision makers, each with five to six pieces of information to help them make a decision.

facts.fact: The article's illustrative sales-leader pitch claims a CRM system boosts sales team efficiency by 30% (an example pitch, not a measured result).
facts.quote: Our CRM system boosts your sales team’s efficiency by 30%, leading to a potential 20% increase in revenue.

facts.fact: The article's illustrative operations-leader pitch claims a CRM reduces manual data entry by 40% (an example pitch, not a measured result).
facts.quote: It reduces manual data entry by 40%, freeing up your team to focus on strategic initiatives.
